description: Department of Census & Statistics - National Consumer Price Index for the month of January, 2017
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for January 2017, as computed by the Department of Census and Statistics. It does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial). The content is a statistical announcement related to economic data, which falls under general administrative matters not covered by the other categories, making it Miscellaneous (Type 10).
